top_signals.title: The Danish retailer plotting to outsmart ‘unsentimental’ Modella Capital
top_signals.summary: On the modern-day British high street, a Scandinavian shop featuring maze-like aisles, quirky homeware and bags of licorice near the till is not quite a reinvention of the wheel.  But Mikkel Grene, chief executive of Danish homeware retailer Søstrene Grene, believes his business can go toe-to-toe with Ikea and Flying Tiger for pride of place [...]

top_signals.title: Bond rout ending? Massive bets on bond rally dominate options market
top_signals.summary: There's an old Wall Street adage: Stocks float on a sea of bonds. Options traders are betting the tide is going out.

top_signals.summary: Microsoft updated its Windows PowerToys toolset with a new utility dubbed "Window Hopper" that lets users switch between an app's windows more quickly. [...]
